reason: The remediation only edits PAM password quality configuration files to set the minlen parameter. This is a standard STIG hardening step, does not modify kernel, bootloader, or filesystem layout, and carries minimal risk of lockout if the desired length is reasonable. Therefore it is safe to apply automatically.
estimated_impact: authentication/authorization affected; Potential for users to be unable to set passwords shorter than the new minimum if the value is set too high; Misconfiguration could affect password change operations
